ns2:section.sectionText: Course is a hybrid with one day in person and one day online at time specified in Course Explorer. Topic: Introduction to US Law and Legal Institutions. This course is designed for pre-law students, as well as students who are interested in politics and law in general. It provides an introduction to the basics of the American legal system, including law-making institutions, the court system, and legal actors. We will also explore the foundations of American law, such as federalism, separation of powers and the Bill of Rights. The course offers an overview of some of the topics and vocabulary that first year law students are likely to encounter. And finally, the course offers some insights and perspectives on legal education and the legal profession.
